page.content:
Homeric epic of Achilles' wrath in the ninth year at Troy.

How Iliad connects

  • Event: Trojan War — The Iliad recounts Achilles' portion of the Trojan War.
  • Creator: Homer — The Iliad is attributed to Homer.
  • Work: Odyssey — The Odyssey follows the Iliad as the nostos after Troy.

What is Iliad?

The Iliad narrates a few weeks of the Trojan War: the quarrel of Achilles and Agamemnon, the death of Patroclus, and the ransoming of Hector's body.

Key threads lead to Trojan War, Homer and Odyssey.
